description: One message channel bound to an MCP server the plugin provides. Unknown keys are rejected.

server.description: Name of the MCP server this channel binds to. Must match a key in the plugin's mcpServers (not checked by claude plugin validate).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the config dialog title (for example Telegram). Defaults to the server name.
displayName.x-source: CLI 2.1.281 runtime schema and CLI-generated channel scaffold; not on the docs Channels section

userConfig.description: Fields to prompt for when the plugin is enabled; same schema as the top-level userConfig. Values are referenced as ${user_config.KEY} in the bound server's configuration.
